about.description:
Third-year student in the five-year program at National Taichung University of Science and Technology (NTCUST), majoring in Information Management, with a focus on full-stack web development and AI application integration. Experienced in building end-to-end systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB, with hands-on projects including a real-time chat application (chat.to) and an academic terminology normalization Chrome extension (TermExpander-ai). These projects span real-time messaging architecture, third-party service integration, authentication design, and multi-provider LLM orchestration.

Currently exploring the engineering side of generative AI, including LLM API integration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline design, agentic AI system architecture, and embedding AI capabilities into browser-based and web application workflows. Interested in designing AI agents that can autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks, bridging the gap between standalone model calls and practical, goal-driven automation. Committed to building the kind of infrastructure users only notice when it's missing, with a growing depth in real-time systems, frontend performance optimization, and secure authentication patterns.
